headline: Türkiye Posts Record October Goods Exports of $25.9 Billion
summary: Türkiye achieved its highest-ever October goods exports, with outbound shipments rising 8.1% year-on-year to $25.9 billion, according to Trade Minister Ömer Bolat.
why: Export performance is a key indicator of manufacturing strength, foreign exchange generation, and overall economic activity in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: Record export volumes reflect positively on the country's manufacturing output and current account.
